description: This file defines the SearchProductList class, which extends ProductList and represents search results including category facets.

classes.name: SearchProductList
classes.description: Represents a list of products resulting from a search query, with additional category facet information.

methods.name: getCategoryFacets
methods.description: Returns the list of category facets associated with the search results.

methods.name: setCategoryFacets
methods.description: Sets the list of category facets for the search results.
